title: Restricted adjunctions on $\Dctf$
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be admissible and $f:X\to Y$ separated of finite type. On the
full subcategories $\Dctf(-,\Lambda)$:

1. $f^*\dashv Rf_*$, as the restriction of the adjunction on
   $D(-_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$;
2. $-\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\dashv\cHom(K,-)$ for $K\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$, as the
   restriction of the tensor–Hom adjunction on $D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$;
3. $Rf_!\dashv f^!$, as the restriction of the adjunction on
   $\Loc(\Dctf(-,\Lambda))$ of [sk-prop-sf-existence].

proof.text:
If $F:\mathcal C\rightleftarrows\mathcal D:G$ is an adjunction and
$\mathcal C'\subset\mathcal C$, $\mathcal D'\subset\mathcal D$ are full
subcategories with $F(\mathcal C')\subset\mathcal D'$ and
$G(\mathcal D')\subset\mathcal C'$, then the natural bijections
$\Hom_{\mathcal D}(FC,D)\simeq\Hom_{\mathcal C}(C,GD)$ for $C\in\mathcal C'$,
$D\in\mathcal D'$ are bijections of Hom sets of $\mathcal D'$ and $\mathcal C'$
by fullness, so $F|_{\mathcal C'}\dashv G|_{\mathcal D'}$, with the same unit and
counit. By [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images] and
[det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-internal-hom], $f^*$, $Rf_*$, $Rf_!$, $f^!$,
$-\otimes^{\mathbf L}K$ and $\cHom(K,-)$ preserve $\Dctf$. The ambient derived pullback–pushforward adjunction is supplied by
[def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction] (its $Lf^*$ is the $f^*$ notation used here), and the ambient tensor–Hom adjunction is
supplied by [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], as $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\Lambda_X}-\dashv\RHom_{\Lambda_X}(K,-)$ with $\cHom(K,-)=\RHom_{\Lambda_X}(K,-)$; since $\Lambda_X$ is commutative, the termwise symmetry of $\otimes_{\Lambda_X}$ (with the Koszul sign) on a K-flat resolution of $K$ gives a natural isomorphism $M\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\simeq K\otimes^{\mathbf L}M$, and composing the Hom bijections with it gives $-\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\dashv\cHom(K,-)$ on $D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)=D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$. Apply this to the
ambient adjunctions $f^*\dashv Rf_*$ and $-\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\dashv\cHom(K,-)$
on $D(-_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$, and to $Rf_!\dashv f^!$ on the localizing
categories $\Loc(\Dctf(-,\Lambda))$, which contain $\Dctf(-,\Lambda)$ as a full
subcategory.

Dctf sits inside it as a full subcategory (sk-def-sfb-constructible), and Loc(Dctf) is a full subcategory of the same category that contains Dctf, so all three clauses are restrictions along full inclusions. The full-subcategory restriction lemma is correct. Clause checks: (1) the ambient adjunction Lf^*⊣Rf_* is def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction, and preservation is direct-images (1),(3). (2) The ambient adjunction is sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom layer B; preservation is direct-images (1) for ⊗ and det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-internal-hom for cHom. (3) The ambient adjunction is sk-prop-sf-existence on Loc(Dctf) with Rf_!=Rp_*D(j_!) over the standing schemes of sk-def-sfb-dc-setting; preservation is direct-images (3),(4), whose (4) uses explicit preservation statements, not existence alone. A reachability check shows the DAG is acyclic. Edge cases checked: empty X, K=0, f=id, field coefficients, proper f (consistent with det-cor-existence-ii-restriction). There are no new nodes. There are no duplicates: def-sfb-dc-upper-lower-adjunction and def-sfb-dc-tensor-hom-adjunction are about D_cons, not Dctf. I accept the tool use of sk-prop-sf-existence, which the blueprint node itself cites; the two definition entries are notions and harmless.
